newsitem.title: USA: BMC Industries Q1 net rises on unit growth.
newsitem.headline: BMC Industries Q1 net rises on unit growth.

text.p: BMC Industries Inc said Wednesday all of its division contributed to a solid sales increase that helped earnings climb in the first quarter ended March 31.
The company reported net income of $7.9 million, or $0.28 a share, up from $6.1 million, or $0.22, in the same period last year. Revenues climbed to $77.1 million, from $68.3 million last year.
The company said two divisions, the Precision Imaged Products and Optical Products units, posted record sales in the first quarter through double-digit growth.
BMC Industries makes aperture masks for color television tubes and computer monitors in addition to polycarbonate, glass and plastic eyewear lenses.
Its shares were up 2 Wednesday at 26-3/4.
